changes.to: Values from Bear Robotics' Servi page (checked 2026-11-25): 44.5 x 43 x 104.6 cm, drive speed 0.1-1.2 m/s, 2 trays plus 1 bus tub, 10 kg per tray and 66 lb (30 kg) total, battery life 10-12 h with a 4 h wall-charger recharge, 7-inch screen, NSF-certified, LiDAR and cameras with real-time rerouting, internal weight sensors for auto return. Runtime is given as a 10-12 h range, 10 h used as the value. The same page also lists Servi mini (98 cm, 1 tray, 44 lb total); this record is the full-size Servi. Weight is not published.
Bear Robotics' Servi is a restaurant delivery robot: a LiDAR-navigated tray carrier that runs food and buses tables for a 10-12 hour shift, carrying 10 kg per tray and 30 kg in total.
